title: 第二百三十四章 悲惨的鬼丸第二百三十三章 三星扇
lines: 第二百三十四章悲惨的鬼丸
三星扇，算是沙忍村中比较顶级的宝物，对于风遁有着极大的加成，适合强大的风遁忍者使用。
玄风的风遁在夜天云看来确实称得上一流，因此被授予三星扇的使用权也是无可厚非。
“低估你们的实力了。”夜天云淡淡的说道，眼眸深处那淡淡的戏谑之色已经消失，取而代之的是平淡的神色。
这平淡并非代表着轻视，而是代表着此时的夜天云打算用平常心战斗。
也就是说他准备全力而战。
此时夜天云的心思在高速运转，他在冷静的分析着最佳的攻击顺序。
“叶苍的灼遁是个不小的麻烦，沾上一丝就是丧命，风尘的能力想必有些古怪，保险起见先探探他的虚实在说，玄风的风遁术虽然强大，但擅长远战的忍者近战一般都不是强项，那么。。。”
夜天云嘴角泛起一丝微笑，眼中闪过一丝精光，接着瞬间消失不见。
看见突然消失不见的夜天云，叶苍等人瞬间明白那是夜天云启动了他的血迹能力，而他们也在瞬间便想到夜天云偷袭的第一个目标会是不擅长近战的玄风，因此叶苍已经操控火球向玄风飞去。
风尘则是向玄风的身边靠拢，而鬼丸眼神一凝，那个人形傀儡瞬间向玄风的身边冲了过去，同时傀儡的下巴脱落，露出了一个枪管。
不出所料，此时夜天云的身影已经出现在了玄风的身侧。
玄风虽然十分惊诧，但也是早有准备，急忙向侧方撤去。
而与此同时，其余三人的攻击一齐而至。
叶苍的火球距离夜天云落脚的地点不过一尺之遥，风尘也已经来到了玄风的身边，而人傀儡嘴中的枪管则是射出了一根根尖锐的千本。
那一根根细长的千本上泛着紫色的光芒，显然是淬有剧毒。
此时的夜天云刚刚站定，魂知中已然将四面八方的攻击景象完全呈现在脑海中，眼中的笑意更甚。
“瞬步！”夜天云瞬间消失在原地，下一秒他已经出现在了鬼丸的面前。
显然他是早有预料，叶苍等人既然能够猜到夜天云的攻击目标，夜天云又怎会想不到叶苍等人的想法从而声东击西？
瞬间出现在玄风的面前只是佯攻而已，实际上他早已准备用瞬步偷袭鬼丸。
而叶苍等人没有料到夜天云的真实速度竟会达到如此地步，毫无征兆便出现在了鬼丸的面前，而之前他站立的地面上还泛着一丝残像。
夜天云的刀锋已经斩向了鬼丸的胸口。
只是下一刻，鬼丸的嘴忽然裂开，只见眼前的鬼丸已经完全变了模样。
他哪里还是沙忍中的傀儡师鬼丸，而是一个真正的傀儡！
此时那傀儡的嘴中闪着一抹淡黄色的光芒，夜天云眼瞳一缩，接下来一道震耳欲聋的爆炸声响起，那傀儡瞬间自爆。
这次自爆的威力极大，宛如数十枚起爆符同时爆炸一般，其威力已不逊于任何A级忍术。
content_en:
Chapter 234 The miserable Onimaru
The three-star fan is considered to be the top treasure in the Sand Ninja Village. It has a great bonus to wind escape and is suitable for powerful wind escape ninjas.
In Ye Tianyun's opinion, Xuanfeng's wind escape was indeed top-notch, so it was understandable that he was granted the right to use the three-star fan.
"I underestimated your strength." Ye Tianyun said lightly, the faint teasing look in the depths of his eyes disappeared, replaced by a dull look.
This plainness does not mean contempt, but means that Ye Tianyun intends to fight with a normal heart at this time.
In other words, he is ready to fight with all his strength.
At this time, Ye Tianyun's mind was running at high speed, and he was calmly analyzing the best attack sequence.
"Ye Cang's Burning Escape is a big trouble. If you get a trace of it, you will die. Feng Chen's ability must be a bit weird. To be on the safe side, let's test his strength first. Although Xuanfeng's Wind Escape is powerful, ninjas who are good at long-distance combat are generally not strong in close combat, so..."
A smile appeared at the corner of Ye Tianyun's mouth, a glimmer of light flashed in his eyes, and then disappeared in an instant.
Seeing Ye Tianyun who suddenly disappeared, Ye Cang and others instantly understood that it was Ye Tianyun who had activated his bloodstain ability, and they also instantly thought that the first target of Ye Tianyun's sneak attack would be Xuanfeng, who was not good at melee combat, so Ye Cang had already controlled the fireball to fly towards Xuanfeng.
Feng Chen moved closer to Xuanfeng, while Onimaru's eyes focused, and the humanoid puppet instantly rushed towards Xuanfeng. At the same time, the puppet's chin fell off, revealing a gun barrel.
As expected, Ye Tianyun's figure had appeared beside Xuanfeng at this time.
Although Xuanfeng was very surprised, he was already prepared and hurriedly retreated to the side.
At the same time, the attacks from the other three people came at the same time.
Ye Cang's fireball was only a foot away from where Ye Tianyun landed. Feng Chen had also arrived at Xuanfeng's side, and the barrel of the gun in the puppet's mouth shot out sharp qianben.
The slender thousand books were glowing with purple light, which was obviously poisonous.
At this time, Ye Tianyun had just stood still, and the scene of attacks from all directions was completely presented in his mind in his soul, and the smile in his eyes was even bigger.
"Shunpo!" Ye Tianyun disappeared instantly, and the next second he appeared in front of Onimaru.
Obviously he had expected it. Since Ye Cang and others could guess the target of Ye Tianyun's attack, how could Ye Tianyun not think of Ye Cang and others' ideas and attack in the east?
The moment he appeared in front of Genfeng was just a feint attack. In fact, he had already prepared to sneak attack Onimaru with Shunpo.
However, Ye Cang and others did not expect that Ye Tianyun's true speed would reach such an extent. He appeared in front of Onimaru without any warning, and there was still an afterimage on the ground where he was standing before.
Ye Tianyun's blade had already slashed towards Onimaru's chest.
But the next moment, Onimaru's mouth suddenly split open, and Onimaru in front of him had completely changed his appearance.
He is no longer the puppet master Onimaru among the sand ninjas, but a real puppet!
At this time, a light yellow light flashed in the mouth of the puppet. Ye Tianyun's pupils shrank, and then a deafening explosion sounded, and the puppet instantly self-destructed.
The power of this self-destruction is extremely powerful, just like dozens of detonating charms exploding at the same time. Its power is no less powerful than any A-level ninjutsu.
